description: `routes.trace` (test bench): one request on a route, sent once, with the JSON body the adapter built and the raw reply the server sent, plus what the adapter read out of that reply. `thinkingChars` 0 beside a raw reply that carries reasoning is the bug this method exists to show. The per-call `reasoningEffort` and `extraBody` change the request for this call only and store nothing; the credential is never in the result.
